lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in a non-uniform grid. In the central mid-flank, blobs are organized into roughly vertical columns of 3 to 5 units, with increasing inter-blob distance observed toward the posterior-dorsal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible in the central flank area, aligning with the vertical columns of high-luminance blobs to form a visible grid-like nodal structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper-mid section of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient transition from high-luminance highlight on the superior edge to low-luminance shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three distinct lower-luminance silhouettes (remoras) in the ventral-posterior field of view below the pectoral fin.
